description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' within the 'JmesPath' namespace, providing static methods for type checking, object/array validation, comparison, sorting, and slicing, used internally by the JMESPath PHP implementation.
external_files: php standard library functions (gettype, get_object_vars, method_exists, etc.)

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for type determination, object/array validation, comparison, sorting, and slicing operations used in JMESPath processing.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Checks if a value is considered truthy in JMESPath context.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the JMESPath type equivalent of a PHP variable.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Determines if a value is a JMESPath-compatible object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Determines if a value is a JMESPath-compatible array.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Performs a JSON-aware comparison between two values.

methods.name: stableSort
methods.description: Performs a stable sort on an array using a custom comparison function.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Creates a Python-style slice of an array or string.

methods.name: adjustEndpoint
methods.description: Adjusts a slice endpoint considering negative indices.

methods.name: adjustSlice
methods.description: Adjusts start and stop indices for slicing.

methods.name: sliceIndices
methods.description: Generates a sliced subset of an array or string based on start, stop, and step.
